title.zh: Uniswap Labs向应用开放手续费兑换工具TJAR，Robinhood成首个合作方
title.en: Uniswap Labs向应用开放手续费兑换工具TJAR，Robinhood成首个合作方

current_state.zh: Uniswap Labs has open-sourced its Token Jar fee-conversion tool as TJAR, with Robinhood becoming the first integrator using it to convert collected fees into USDC and USDG across supported chains.
